hook: Every shop is a menu of texts: your Changelings wear other tribes' units and leave a 1-gold Stock behind.
loop: Use Guise: a Changeling wears a shop unit, leaving a Stock.
Wearers grow from Nursemaid, Bee Orchid and Mummers; Stocks fill the board.
Bettie, the Lady and copies of your carry turn wears into power.

growth.line: Steady, every turn: each wear and each guised Changeling gains permanent stats; Bettie scales late.

feel.early: Cheap Guise units; tempo hangs on shop luck.
feel.mid: Wearing many tribes, Stocks filling the board, steady growth.
feel.late: Copied carries, golden texts, Bettie stacks; very high rolls.

stars.why: Copies your own carry's text; the tribe's best hidden combo.
Every Stock becomes a second copy of a shop unit's text.
Three borrowed texts on one body; the oldest falls off.

card_short.u01: Guise: wears a shop unit's text and tribe.
card_short.u02: Guise; grows permanently each time it wears a unit.
card_short.u03: Guise, but the worn text swaps left and right.
card_short.u04: Each time a Changeling wears a unit, it grows permanently.
card_short.u05: Once a turn, a wear gives you 1 gold.
card_short.u06: Your Changelings can wear units one tier higher.
card_short.u07: Guise; at Start of Combat also wears the enemy across.
card_short.u08: End of Turn: grows every Changeling that has a guise.
card_short.u09: Once a turn, a bought Stock wears its replaced unit.
card_short.u10: Guise that can also copy a unit on your board.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: grows Changelings for each different tribe worn.
card_short.u12: Once a turn, a wear triggers its When played text.
card_short.u13: Guise; may wear units you sell, taking half their stats.
card_short.u14: Every bought Stock wears its replaced unit and gains +3/+3.
card_short.u15: When a Changeling dies, takes its guises and +4/+4.
card_short.u16: Guise; keeps up to three guises at once.
card_short.u17: Guise; your other Changelings wear golden text.
card_short.u18: End of Turn: Changelings grow for each guise put on.
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: front row copies and wipes enemies across.
card_short.x01: 1-gold 0/3 left in the worn unit's shop slot.

builds.name: The Masquerade
builds.line: Guise units in different tribes; Nursemaid, Bee Orchid, Mummers grow them.

builds.name: The Stock Exchange
builds.line: Whittler then Moll make Stocks wear; a full board feeds Bettie.

builds.name: Copy your carry
builds.line: Tam and Grandfer copy one strong text; the Lady makes it golden.

liked: Every shop becomes a menu of texts; Refresh and Freeze choose what units become.
Tam Twice copying your own carry is the best hidden combo, now clearly ruled.
worries: Watch: Bettie, Lady and Grandfer copies stack to hundreds of stats a turn.
Watch: Moll's 1-gold Stocks, fed to Tod, may make buying Stocks always right.
changed: Stock no longer wears alone; only Whittler or Moll makes it wear.
Every Changeling can wear up to your tier minus 2, so early wearers last.
Pip now mirrors only left and right; Guise timing and counting rules spelled out.
verdict: Every shop becomes a wardrobe of other tribes' cards, made for players who love misusing them.
